description: Basic-knowledge client with partial-loss ETF — no rules fail, score 100 SUITABLE
client_narrative: Amina Diallo is 35 years old and works as a secondary school teacher, earning a gross salary of 3,750 euros per month. She holds 30,000 euros across a current account and an easy-access savings account at her bank. She wants to invest 20,000 euros and is comfortable keeping the money invested for five years. Her investment experience is limited to savings accounts and one fixed-term deposit she opened three years ago — she has never purchased shares, funds, or any other investment product. She considers herself moderately cautious: 'I can stomach some ups and downs, but nothing too volatile.' She has not stated whether she could afford to lose her entire investment.
product_narrative: The product is an exchange-traded fund that passively replicates the MSCI World Index, covering roughly 1,500 large and mid-cap companies across 23 developed equity markets. The fund is listed on multiple European exchanges, trades intraday with full liquidity, publishes a KIID, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives or complex payoff structures.
